content.text: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation exists anywhere in the document. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: Licensee acknowledges that the grant of the license set forth in this Section is a non-exclusive license and that the Licensor shall have the right to use and to license to other parties the Licensed Technology for any purpose and in any manner as Licensor may determine in its sole discretion.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on us, so it meets the preferred position. The licence is repeatedly and expressly "Non Exclusive" (preamble, Art. II §iii at p0030, Art. IV at p0049, Art. V at p0050), and nothing requires us to source Spot FX connectivity, liquidity or platform services solely from Licensor, to route all trading volume through the Platform, or to refrain from using competing platforms or providers. The volume-band fee table and rebate mechanics (p0056-p0076) price actual usage but set no minimum-volume or requirements commitment. The planner-flagged "Right of First Refusal" (Art. XXII, p0139) and the Change of Control consent right (Art. XX, p0134) are corporate-transaction controls, not sourcing restraints, and are properly assessed under ASSIGN/change-of-control rather than EXCLUSIVITY. The "exclusive purpose" wording in the Field of Use definition (p0007) is a field-of-use limit on how we may use Licensor's own Licensed Technology, not a restriction on buying from other suppliers; likewise the distribution/sublicensing restrictions at p0027, p0042 and p0085 govern onward transfer of Licensor's technology only. No fallback analysis is needed, and no redline is proposed.
